zh.plugin.name: K-Vault
zh.plugin.desc: 给「新建远程」加一个 K-Vault 类型，并自带站点上的文件管理：填站点地址和令牌，测通后一键建好远程；列表、删除、上传都在插件里做，只有文件字节由主程序按插件给的说明流出去。
zh.panel.ready: 站点和令牌都填好了，可以建远程
zh.panel.todo: 先填站点地址；建远程还需要令牌
zh.check.unset: 未填（只能浏览，不能上传）
zh.hint.site: 填你打开 K-Vault 网站的那个地址，例如 https://kv.example.com。结尾多写的 /dav 会被自动去掉。
zh.hint.remote: 建出来的远程类型是 webdav——K-Vault 在 rclone 里本来就是 webdav，只是多了几个参数。上传时字节由主程序流出去，但发到哪个地址、带什么认证头、表单里放哪些字段，全由插件给；主程序里没有站点地址，也不知道 K-Vault 是什么。
zh.site.bad_base: 站点地址要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
zh.site.missing_token: 建远程需要访问令牌：WebDAV 通道只读，上传要靠令牌
zh.site.max_file_default: 站点没报单文件上限，按默认 {0} MB 算
zh.remote.bad_name: 远程名不能包含冒号、斜杠或空格
zh.remote.provider_fail: 无法向 rclone 查询后端列表：{0}
zh.remote.no_provider: 当前连着的 rclone 没有 webdav 后端，远程没创建（{0}）
zh.remote.no_provider_empty: 后端列表是空的，先确认 rclone 连上了
zh.hint.migrate: 旧版主程序里的 K-Vault 远程，点「扫描旧设置」就能列出来。迁移只往插件自己的存储里记一份清单，一个字节都不改 rclone 配置——你随时可以退回旧版，那些远程照样能用。
zh.hint.data: 导出的是这份清单加站点设置，默认不含令牌，可以直接贴给别人看。卸载插件会连存储一起删掉，所以卸载前先导出一份。恢复不会覆盖你正在用的站点设置，只补缺的条目。
zh.data.need_pick: 先在「记录名」里填一条要用的名字（扫描完会自动填上第一条）
zh.data.adopt_missing: 清单里没有 {0} 这一条，先点「扫描旧设置」
zh.data.adopt_ok: 已把 {0} 填进表单，还没测过；确认无误再点「建远程」
zh.data.adopt_none: 已把 {0} 的地址和参数填进表单，但没找到令牌，请自己补一个
zh.data.migrate_none: 没找到 K-Vault 远程：rclone 里没有带 kvault 标记的配置
zh.data.migrate_ok: 找到 {0} 个 K-Vault 远程，清单里现在有 {1} 条
zh.data.seeded: 站点设置原来是空的，已用 {0} 填上
zh.data.export_empty: 还没有能导出的东西：既没扫描过旧设置，也没填过站点
zh.data.export_ok: 已导出（含令牌），内容在下面的框里，也已复制到剪贴板
zh.data.export_plain: 已导出（不含令牌），内容在下面的框里，也已复制到剪贴板
zh.data.copy_fail: 已导出，但复制到剪贴板失败：{0}
zh.data.restore_empty: 先把导出的内容粘到下面的框里
zh.data.bad_shape: 不是 K-Vault 的导出文件
zh.data.restore_ok: 已恢复，新增 {0} 条记录
zh.data.restore_site_kept: 现有站点设置保留不动，只补了缺的条目
zh.hint.files: 「站点上的文件」用的是上面的站点设置；也可以点名一条迁移记录，动那个站点的目录。上传时字节由主程序按 multipart 流出去，只发你这次在「要上传的文件」里挑的那一个，别的路径它不认。
zh.files.no_remote: 清单里没有 {0} 这一条，先扫描旧设置，或者留空用上面的站点
zh.files.bad_record: 清单里 {0} 这一条不完整，缺站点地址
zh.files.no_token: {0} 这条没有可用的令牌，先在站点表单里填一个
zh.files.need_id: 先填要删的文件 id（列表里每行最后一列）
zh.files.confirm: 真的要删掉 {0} 吗？删了就没了。
zh.files.need_file: 先用「要上传的文件」后面的浏览按钮挑一个文件
zh.files.need_cap: 主程序还不支持 http.upload 这个能力，所以没发出去。插件这边已经准备好了：把这段地址和表单交给主程序就能流式发送（见 HOST-CONTRACT.md 的 H8）。
zh.files.deduped: 站点认出去重，没存第二份
zh.files.plan_ok: 要发的请求都在下面的框里，什么都没发出去
zh.files.plan_partial: 还差一点才能列出请求

en.plugin.name: K-Vault
en.plugin.desc: Adds a K-Vault type to New Remote and the site's file list: fill in the address and token, test, then create. Listing, deleting and uploading all happen in the plugin; the main program only streams the file's bytes the way the plugin asks.
en.req.parse: The request is not valid JSON: {0}
en.panel.ready: Site and token are set; the remote can be created
en.panel.todo: Fill in the site address first; creating a remote also needs a token
en.hint.site: Use the address where you open the K-Vault site, for example https://kv.example.com. A trailing /dav is removed for you.
en.hint.remote: The remote is created as a webdav remote — in rclone K-Vault is webdav with a few extra parameters. The main program streams the bytes on upload, but the address, the auth header and every form field come from the plugin; the main program holds no site address and does not know what K-Vault is.
en.site.missing_base: Fill in the site address first
en.site.bad_base: The site address must start with http:// or https://
en.site.missing_token: Creating a remote needs an access token: the WebDAV channel is read-only
en.site.not_json: The site did not return JSON (HTTP {0}): {1}
en.site.max_file_default: the site did not report a size cap; assuming {0} MB
en.remote.need_name: The remote name cannot be empty
en.remote.bad_name: The remote name cannot contain colons, slashes or spaces
en.remote.provider_fail: Cannot ask rclone for its backend list: {0}
en.remote.no_provider: The connected rclone has no webdav backend, so nothing was created ({0})
en.remote.no_provider_empty: The backend list is empty; check that rclone is connected
en.hint.migrate: Click “Scan old settings” to list the K-Vault remotes the old main program left in rclone. Migrating only records an inventory inside this plugin; it does not change rclone's config by a single byte, so you can still go back to the old version and keep using those remotes.
en.hint.data: The export holds that inventory plus your site settings, without tokens unless you ask for them, so it is safe to paste into a bug report. Uninstalling the plugin deletes its storage too — export first. Restoring never overwrites the site settings you are using now; it only fills in what is missing.
en.data.need_pick: Type a name into “Record” first (scanning fills in the first one for you)
en.data.adopt_missing: The inventory has no {0}; click “Scan old settings” first
en.data.adopt_ok: Filled {0} into the form — untested; click “Create remote” once it looks right
en.data.adopt_none: Filled the address and parameters of {0} into the form, but no token was found — add one yourself
en.data.migrate_none: No K-Vault remote found: nothing in rclone carries the kvault marker
en.data.migrate_ok: Found {0} K-Vault remote(s); the inventory now holds {1} record(s)
en.data.seeded: The site settings were empty, so {0} was filled in
en.data.export_empty: Nothing to export yet: old settings were never scanned and no site was filled in
en.data.export_ok: Exported (with tokens); the text is in the box below and on your clipboard
en.data.export_plain: Exported (without tokens); the text is in the box below and on your clipboard
en.data.copy_fail: Exported, but copying to the clipboard failed: {0}
en.data.restore_empty: Paste an export into the box below first
en.data.bad_shape: that is not a K-Vault export
en.data.restore_site_kept: your current site settings were left untouched, only missing records were added
en.hint.files: The file page uses the site settings above; you can also name a migrated record to work inside that site's folder. During an upload the main program streams the bytes as multipart and sends only the one file you picked in the file field — it does not accept any other path.
en.files.no_remote: There is no record named {0}; scan old settings first, or leave the field empty to use the site above
en.files.bad_record: The record {0} is incomplete: it has no site address
en.files.no_token: The record {0} has no usable token; fill one in the site form first
en.files.bad_body: The site did not answer with JSON: {0}
en.files.need_id: Fill in the id of the file to delete (the last column of each listed line)
en.files.confirm: Delete {0} for real? There is no undo.
en.files.need_file: Pick a file with the browse button next to the file field first
en.files.need_cap: The main program has no http.upload capability yet, so nothing was sent. The plugin side is ready: hand it this address and form and the upload can be streamed (see H8 in HOST-CONTRACT.md).
en.files.deduped: the site recognised a duplicate, so no second copy was stored
en.files.plan_ok: The requests to send are in the box below; nothing was sent
en.files.plan_partial: Not enough to list the requests yet
